The previous step make_5_lvl2-apply_template-4 asked: "Can you return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl2-template_search-4 to the molecule below?" So there is a molecule below, but not shown in prompt. Possibly the system expects we retrieve from prior step? Not available. We may need to search template catalog with criteria: functional groups broken/formed etc. The reaction: Still-Gennari HWE forms Z-alkene from aldehyde + phosphonate ester. So forward reaction forms C=C double bond and carboxylic ester (from phosphonate?). Broken bonds: C-P, C-C (maybe the phosphonate carbon attached to P broken), also C=O of aldehyde broken? Actually aldehyde C=O becomes C=C, so C=O broken, C-H of aldehyde broken, C-P broken, C-O of phosphonate broken? Formed: C=C double bond, C-O of ester (carboxylate). Also triple bond of alkyne changed to single? Not relevant maybe.

We need to search templates with functional_groups_broken includes "aldehyde", "phosphonate"? functional_groups_formed includes "alkene", "carboxylic_ester". Let's get list of functional groups available.
